subject: government
topic: International organisations: UN, AU, ECOWAS, Commonwealth, OPEC

kept.q: Which of the following international organisations has its membership restricted only to countries located on the African continent?
options: Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC)
kept.explanation: The African Union is made up only of African states, unlike the UN, Commonwealth, and OPEC, which have members from different continents. This makes it a purely continental organisation.
kept.pidgin: African Union na only African kontries dey inside am. UN, Commonwealth, and OPEC get members from different continents, but AU na only Africa.

kept.q: Under the ECOWAS Protocol on Free Movement of Persons, what right is granted to citizens of member states travelling within the sub-region?
options: Automatic citizenship of any member state after six months
The right to vote in the national elections of any member state
The right to enter and stay in another member state for up to 90 days without a visa
The right to hold a government ministerial post in another member state
kept.explanation: The ECOWAS Protocol allows citizens of member states to enter another member country visa-free and stay for up to 90 days, promoting regional integration. It does not grant automatic citizenship, voting rights, or government positions.
kept.pidgin: ECOWAS Protocol give citizens power to waka enter another member kontri witout visa and stay for 90 days. E no mean say dem go automatically become citizen, vote, or hold government post.

kept.q: A member country of OPEC wants to help raise the global price of crude oil. Based on OPEC's usual method of controlling oil prices, what should this country do?
options: Increase its production above its agreed quota
Comply with an OPEC-agreed cut in its production quota
Withdraw from OPEC and sell oil at any price it wants
Fix oil prices directly with each buyer nation
kept.explanation: OPEC controls global oil prices mainly by agreeing on production quotas among members; cutting output reduces supply and pushes prices up. Increasing production or acting independently would work against this goal.
kept.pidgin: OPEC dey control oil price by make members agree to cut how much oil dem go produce; if supply reduce, price go rise. If kontri increase production or waka comot to sell anyhow, e no go help raise price.

kept.q: The Commonwealth of Nations mainly promotes cooperation among its member countries in which of these areas?
options: Formation of a joint military defence pact
Adoption of a single currency and customs union
Religious integration policies for all members
Democracy, human rights, trade and development cooperation
kept.explanation: The Commonwealth focuses on promoting democracy, human rights, trade, and development among its member states, which share historical ties to Britain. It is not a military alliance, a currency union, or a religious body.
kept.pidgin: Commonwealth dey focus on promote democracy, human rights, trade, and development among im members wey get historical connection to Britain. E no be military alliance, currency union, or religious group.
